newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Processing says top executives resign.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Processing says top executives resign.

text.p: National Processing Inc said Wednesday that two of its senior executives, Richard A. Alston and Kurt S. Knipp, were resigning to pursue other interests, effective immediately.
Alston had been executive vice president, finance and corporate development and Knipp had been executive vice president, merchant card services, the company said.

Knipp's duties will be assumed by Thomas A. Wimsett, currently executive vice president, merchant check services, it said. The merchant card and merchant check services divisions will be combined under Wimsett.
No replacement for Alston has been named.

National Processing provides transaction processing services and customized processing solutions. The company is 85 percent owned by National City Corp, a financial services company based in Cleveland, Ohio.
